source: Lilly Christian Astrology original first edition 1647 Wellcome b30338724
title: If Mother had difficult Travell in Natives Birth or may live after it

groups.source_group: Printed childbirth heading and oblique-rising dangerous labour combination

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CXXIII If the Mother had difficult Travell
claims.historical_source_meaning: Printed CXXIII begins top PDF606 as a distinct question on birth difficulty and mother's survival, not mother status in CXXII.
The author selects signs of oblique ascension, whose symbolic list in first edition needs an exact glyph audit before encoding.
The original oblique sign must be rising rather than merely present elsewhere in the figure.
An unfavorable planet must afflict Ascendant for a claimed difficult labor, not simply an oblique sign alone.
Square aspect is explicitly one alternative form of affliction.
Opposition is the separate adverse aspect alternative to square.
A lunar-node condition in Ascendant is an additional potential trigger, historically symbolized.
The author predicts hazardous maternal childbirth under those conditions, without actual pregnancy outcomes.

groups.source_group: Long ascensions, beneficial aspects or lunar north node alternative

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Signes of long ascentions in Horoscope
claims.historical_source_meaning: Lilly contrasts long-ascension signs in the Ascendant with oblique ones, not all signs at once.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: with aspect of the good Planets
claims.historical_source_meaning: An aspect of beneficial planets is one supportive alternative in the claimed easy childbirth pattern.
The favorable node is an alternative or modifier in the ascendant; glyph interpretation remains historically qualified.
The author assigns easier childbirth in the favorable long-rising case, not a measured clinical effect.

groups.source_group: Moon benefited, masculine sign and right ascension with sex-specific signs

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Fortunes assist the Moon by Conjunction
claims.historical_source_meaning: The beneficial planets supporting Moon by conjunction constitute one path in the alleged easy delivery rule.
The author additionally allows another supportive aspect to Moon, without specifying numeric orb/weight.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Sun or Moon in a masculine Signe of right ascention
claims.historical_source_meaning: A separate favorable birth claim uses Sun/Moon in traditional masculine right-ascension signs.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Leo Libra Sagittarius in mens Nativities
claims.historical_source_meaning: Lilly supplies these traditional zodiac signs for male nativities; source glyph accuracy not independently verified.
The source provides a different list for female nativities; a historical sex-division, not evidence about childbirth physiology.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: facill and easie egress out of Mothers Womb
claims.historical_source_meaning: The author asserts straightforward delivery for these alternatives; no labor/delivery records tested.

groups.source_group: Slow birth and maternal peril with malefics in twelfth

claims.historical_source_meaning: The author specifically places malefics in twelfth for an alleged difficult birth.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: slow progression of the Native from his Mother
claims.historical_source_meaning: Slowed fetal delivery is claimed in the twelfth malefic case without measured labor duration.
A distinct alleged maternal danger follows the same condition, not a reliable complication forecast.

groups.source_group: Oblique Moon with retrograde stationary or slow planet

claims.historical_source_meaning: Moon must lie in an oblique ascension sign for the author's alternative prolonged labor claim.
Moon associated with a retrograde planet is one additional modifier.
Stationarity is an alternative to retrogradation, not a requirement that both be true.
Slow motion is another distinct alternative planetary condition.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Mother was long in Travell of the Native
claims.historical_source_meaning: Lilly alleges prolonged delivery from those configurations; this is not documented labor timing.

groups.source_group: Tenth ruler eighth and conjecture about maternal childbearing death

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord of the tenth be in the eighth
claims.historical_source_meaning: The tenth-house ruler in the eighth is a standalone alleged maternal risk configuration.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: it may be doubted Mother will dye of Childbearing
claims.historical_source_meaning: The author's qualified death conjecture is not a verified risk estimate, medical finding or actionable prognosis.

groups.source_group: Next printed chapter about father's inheritance, navigation only

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CXXIIII Whether Native will enjoy Estate of Father
claims.historical_source_meaning: Printed CXXIIII begins later PDF606 after divider, a separate financial/inheritance source question.

claims.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Sun conjoyned to Jupiter or Venus by day
claims.historical_source_meaning: The first source phrase of following chapter is a boundary witness; substantive patrimony rules await independent extraction.
